revision_contract: Patch reviewed records; retain previous decisions with operation/date/reason/affected ranges; inherited defaults apply only to explicitly defined fields; split memberships require disjoint union proof
partition_rule: CURRENT_OR_CONSUMED iff the pre-shard effective record has narratively_reconstructed=true or a non-empty consumed_ranges array; ROUTED_OR_UNCONSUMED is the exact complement.
record_identity: SCENARIO uses record_type plus script_id; SUPPLEMENTAL_TRANCHE uses record_type plus tranche_id. META records are shard headers, not data records.
